# Exercise media manifest

<!-- Generated by `npm run media:manifest`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Matrix `1` — **22 exercises**, **31 presentation pairings**, 1 illustrated, 30 outstanding.

A *presentation pairing* is one movement as the workout screen can actually show it: the exercise plus the structure the generator cited for it. The same movement on a bench and on stairs are two pairings and two assets.

The visuals are project-created and have not been reviewed by a qualified fitness professional. Nothing commissioned from this list may depict, or be captioned with, a claim that a structure is safe, sound, or inspected — the app states what it can and cannot assess in its own copy, and a picture must not quietly say otherwise.

**A visual may only illustrate a claim the matrix already holds.** Every key below is one
the matrix holds; commissioning anything not on this list will fail `check:exercise-media`.
